changes.comment: Redesign the session API around one subject per session: `subjectId` routing removed (sendCommand(name, args)), command table is a plain record with read-only sessions supported, notice seam split into host `serializeNotice` and guest `onNotice`, `onJoined`/`onFailed` replaced by an awaitable `ready` promise, pairing vocabulary renamed to codes, and both tap unions gained a `dispose` event.
